sources.title: GitHub - axiomofjoy/amadeus: A music generation and model compression ...
sources.snippet: With Amadeus, you can connect a MIDI device (e.g., an electric keyboard) to your laptop or mobile device, play an input phrase of music, and hear the musical response of an AI trained on classical repertoire. Amadeus creates music with Performance RNN, a model for real-time music generation.

sources.title: AMADEUS Model Technical Brief
sources.snippet: Amadeus is a large language model that offers enhanced linguistic and conversational tasks in English, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Japanese, and Deutsch, developed through the insights acquired from the Guanaco Model prototype (Huggingface).
